question.text: The electric field of a plane electromagnetic wave is given by <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>E</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><msub><mrow><mi>E</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub><mfrac><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>i</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>j</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow><mrow><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt></mrow></mfrac><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">cos</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>k</mi><mi>z</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>ω</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow></mrow></math> . At <math><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> , a positively charged particle is at the point <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mi>y</mi><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mi>z</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>π</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mfenced></math> . If its instantaneous velocity at <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> is <math><msub><mrow><mi>v</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover></math> , the force acting on it due to the wave is:

solution.text:
Force due to electric field is in direction –i^+j^2E0
Force due to magnetic filed is in direction qv→×B→ and v→||k^
